1. **Late primary fails hard:** 2/20 hot wins at loss≤0.35 — systematic cold advantage.  
2. **Threshold dependence:** early endpoint 20/20 hot wins — effect is not threshold-invariant (C_threshold).  
3. **H_FISHER:** primary absent ⇒ mechanism claim rejected; grad-norm proxy not used to rescue Fisher.  
4. **Null at final regime:** matches competing explanation C_null / C_scale (hot faster early, cold catches/wins late).
